title: Deployment Confirmation & Ticket Logging
summary: The HelpDesk deployment logger now keeps a consistent Delta format and posts a fresh confirmation for every new deployed commit.
added: Ticket claimed and ticket unclaimed audit logs with Support IDs.
A deployment-specific update message in the logging channel for every new commit.
changed: Update logs now keep the same visual format while release details come from deployment_notes.json.
Each update includes the deployed commit ID so leadership can confirm the exact revision running on the host.
Restarting or reconnecting the same commit will not create duplicate deployment messages.
Previous deployment update messages remain in the logging channel as release history.
